examples.en: A relaxing shoulder massage relieved the intense tension built up from desk work.
examples.vi: Một buổi mát-xa vai thư giãn đã giải tỏa sự căng cơ dữ dội tích tụ do ngồi làm việc văn phòng.
examples.ipaUs: /ə ɹɪˈlæksɪŋ ˈʃoʊldɚ məˈsɑʒ ɹɪˈlivd ði ɪnˈtɛns ˈtɛnʃən bɪlt ʌp fɹʌm dɛsk wɝk/

examples.en: Athletes frequently receive sports massage therapy before competing in championships.
examples.vi: Các vận động viên thường xuyên tiếp nhận liệu pháp mát-xa thể thao trước khi thi đấu ở các giải vô địch.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈæθˌlits ˈfɹikwəntli ɹəˈsiv spɔɹts məˈsɑʒ ˈθɛɹəpi bɪˈfɔɹ kəmˈpitɪŋ ɪn ˈtʃæmpiənˌʃɪps/

words.vi: dây thần kinh, sự căng thẳng thần kinh
words.senseNote: Hệ thống truyền xung điện trong cơ thể hoặc cảm giác hồi hộp bồn chồn trước sự kiện quan trọng.

examples.en: Deep controlled breathing helped calm her nerves before the job presentation.
examples.vi: Hít thở sâu có kiểm soát đã giúp làm dịu sự căng thẳng hồi hộp của cô ấy trước bài thuyết trình xin việc.
examples.ipaUs: /dip kənˈtɹoʊld ˈbɹiðɪŋ hɛlpt kɑm hɝ nɝvz bɪˈfɔɹ ðə dʒɑb ˌpɹɛzənˈteɪʃən/

examples.en: Peripheral nerves transmit sensory signals from skin receptors to the brain.
examples.vi: Các dây thần kinh ngoại biên truyền tín hiệu cảm giác từ thụ thể da lên não bộ.
examples.ipaUs: /pəˈɹɪfɚəl nɝvz tɹænˈsmɪt ˈsɛnsɚi ˈsɪɡnəlz fɹʌm skɪn ɹɪˈsɛptɚz tu ðə bɹeɪn/

words.vi: cơn ác mộng, nỗi kinh hoàng
words.senseNote: Giấc mơ đáng sợ khi ngủ hoặc một trải nghiệm tồi tệ khủng khiếp trong đời thực.

examples.en: The child woke up crying after having a terrifying nightmare about monsters.
examples.vi: Đứa bé thức giấc khóc òa sau khi gặp một cơn ác mộng kinh hoàng về quái vật.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə tʃaɪld woʊk ʌp ˈkɹaɪɪŋ ˈæftɚ ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈtɛɹəˌfaɪɪŋ ˈnaɪtˌmɛɹ əˈbaʊt ˈmɑnstɚz/

examples.en: Losing his passport and wallet abroad turned the vacation into a complete nightmare.
examples.vi: Mất hộ chiếu và ví tiền ở nước ngoài đã biến kỳ nghỉ thành một cơn ác mộng thực sự.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈluzɪŋ hɪz ˈpæsˌpɔɹt ænd ˈwɔlət əˈbɹɔd tɝnd ðə veɪˈkeɪʃən ˈɪntu ə kəmˈplit ˈnaɪtˌmɛɹ/

words.vi: sự xoa bóp, sự chà xát; điều khó khăn, trở ngại
words.senseNote: Hành động xoa, chà xát bề mặt; hoặc 'the rub' chỉ điểm khó khăn, then chốt.

examples.en: She gave her aching shoulders a gentle rub after typing all afternoon.
examples.vi: Cô ấy xoa bóp nhẹ bờ vai đau nhức sau khi gõ máy tính suốt cả buổi chiều.
examples.ipaUs: /ʃi ɡeɪv hər ˈeɪkɪŋ ˈʃoʊldərz ə ˈdʒɛntəl rʌb ˈæftər ˈtaɪpɪŋ ɔl ˌæftərˈnun/

examples.en: The proposal sounds wonderful, but here is the rub: we lack sufficient funding.
examples.vi: Đề xuất nghe rất tuyệt, nhưng đây mới là điều trở ngại: chúng ta thiếu kinh phí đầy đủ.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə prəˈpoʊzəl saʊndz ˈwʌndərfəl bʌt hɪr ɪz ðə rʌb wi læk səˈfɪʃənt ˈfʌndɪŋ/

words.vi: cú tát, cái tát bằng lòng bàn tay
words.senseNote: Cú đánh bằng lòng bàn tay mở rộng gây đau hoặc phát ra tiếng bốp.

examples.en: The sudden slap echoed loudly across the quiet hallway, startling everyone nearby.
examples.vi: Cú tát bất ngờ vang vọng khắp hành lang yên tĩnh, làm mọi người gần đó giật mình.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə ˈsʌdən slæp ˈɛkoʊd ˈlaʊdli əˈkrɔs ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈhɔlˌweɪ ˈstɑrtəlɪŋ ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˈnɪrˌbaɪ/

examples.en: Losing the championship final was a bitter slap in the face for the ambitious young team.
examples.vi: Thất bại trong trận chung kết giải vô địch là một cái tát cay đắng giáng vào đội bóng trẻ đầy tham vọng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈluzɪŋ ðə ˈtʃæmpiənˌʃɪp ˈfaɪnəl wʌz ə ˈbɪtər slæp ɪn ðə feɪs fɔr ði æmˈbɪʃəs jʌŋ tim/

words.vi: bị làm phiền, cảm thấy khó chịu, bận tâm
words.senseNote: Cảm thấy lo lắng, bức bối hoặc khó chịu vì điều gì đó quấy rầy.

examples.en: He seemed visibly bothered by the continuous loud drilling noise coming from the apartment upstairs.
examples.vi: Anh ta có vẻ khó chịu rõ rệt trước tiếng ồn khoan đục liên tục phát ra từ căn hộ tầng trên.
examples.ipaUs: /hi simd ˈvɪzəbli ˈbɑðərd baɪ ðə kənˈtɪnjuəs laʊd ˈdrɪlɪŋ nɔɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm ði əˈpɑrtmənt ˈʌpˈstɛrz/

examples.en: She did not look particularly bothered by their sharp criticism, remaining poised and calm.
examples.vi: Cô ấy dường như chẳng hề bận tâm trước những lời chỉ trích gay gắt của họ, vẫn giữ vẻ đĩnh đạc và điềm tĩnh.
examples.ipaUs: /ʃi dɪd nɑt lʊk pɑrˈtɪkjələrli ˈbɑðərd baɪ ðɛr ʃɑrp ˈkrɪtəˌsɪzəm rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ pɔɪzd ænd kɑm/

words.vi: tuyệt vọng, khẩn thiết, liều lĩnh, vô cùng
words.senseNote: Với cảm giác lo lắng, tuyệt vọng cùng cực hoặc rất khao khát điều gì đó.

examples.en: The lost mountaineers desperately searched for a cave as freezing blizzard winds intensified.
examples.vi: Những người leo núi bị lạc khẩn thiết tìm kiếm một hang động khi những cơn gió bão tuyết băng giá ngày càng dữ dội.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə lɔst ˈmaʊntəˌnɪrz ˈdɛspərətli sɜrtʃt fɔr ə keɪv æz ˈfrizɪŋ ˈblɪzərd wɪndz ɪnˈtɛnsəˌfaɪd/

examples.en: After working three consecutive night shifts, she desperately needed an uninterrupted night of sleep.
examples.vi: Sau khi làm việc ba ca đêm liên tiếp, cô ấy vô cùng cần một giấc ngủ đêm không bị gián đoạn.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈæftər ˈwɜrkɪŋ θri kənˈsɛkjətɪv naɪt ʃɪfts ʃi ˈdɛspərətli ˈnidəd æn ˌʌnˌɪntəˈrʌptəd naɪt ʌv slip/

words.vi: sự ức chế, cảm giác ngượng ngùng e dè; sự kiềm chế
words.senseNote: Cảm giác e thẹn khiến một người không dám hành động tự nhiên; hoặc sự kìm hãm sinh học.

examples.en: Alcohol impairs cognitive judgment by lowering social inhibition in dangerous ways.
examples.vi: Đồ uống có cồn làm suy giảm khả năng phán đoán nhận thức bằng cách làm giảm sự kiềm chế xã hội theo những cách nguy hiểm.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈælkəˌhɔl ɪmˈpɛrz ˈkɑɡnətɪv ˈdʒʌdʒmənt baɪ ˈloʊərɪŋ ˈsoʊʃəl ˌɪnhəˈbɪʃən ɪn ˈdeɪndʒərəs weɪz/

examples.en: The welcoming drama workshop helped shy teenagers overcome their social inhibition and speak confidently.
examples.vi: Hội thảo kịch nghệ thân thiện đã giúp những thiếu niên nhút nhát vượt qua cảm giác e dè ngượng ngùng để nói năng tự tin.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə ˈwɛlkəmɪŋ ˈdrɑmə ˈwɜrkˌʃɑp hɛlpt ʃaɪ ˈtinˌeɪdʒərz ˌoʊvərˈkʌm ðɛr ˈsoʊʃəl ˌɪnhəˈbɪʃən ænd spik ˈkɑnfədəntli/

words.vi: tiếng rên rỉ, tiếng than vãn
words.senseNote: Âm thanh trầm, kéo dài phát ra khi bị đau đớn, khó chịu hoặc buồn bã.

examples.en: The injured athlete let out a low moan as medical staff carefully examined his sprained ankle.
examples.vi: Vận động viên bị chấn thương khẽ rên rỉ khi nhân viên y tế cẩn thận kiểm tra mắt cá chân bị bong gân của anh.
examples.ipaUs: /ði ˈɪndʒərd ˈæθˌlit lɛt aʊt ə loʊ moʊn æz ˈmɛdəkəl stæf ˈkɛrfəli ɪɡˈzæmɪnd hɪz spreɪnd ˈæŋkəl/

examples.en: Despite minor delays, commuters endured the rainy morning rush without a single audible moan.
examples.vi: Bất chấp những chậm trễ nhỏ, những người đi làm vẫn chịu đựng giờ cao điểm buổi sáng mưa gió mà không có một lời than thở nào.
examples.ipaUs: /dɪˈspaɪt ˈmaɪnər dɪˈleɪz kəˈmjutərz ɛnˈdʊrd ðə ˈreɪni ˈmɔrnɪŋ rʌʃ wɪðˈaʊt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈɔdəbəl moʊn/

words.vi: nhẹ nhõm, bớt lo âu, an tâm
words.senseNote: Cảm thấy vui mừng và thư thái vì điều lo lắng hoặc khó chịu đã qua đi.

examples.en: Parents were tremendously relieved to learn that their daughter arrived safely after the storm.
examples.vi: Các bậc cha mẹ cảm thấy vô cùng nhẹ nhõm khi biết tin con gái mình đã đến nơi an toàn sau cơn bão.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈpɛrənts wɜr trəˈmɛndəsli rɪˈlivd tu lɜrn ðæt ðɛr ˈdɔtər əˈraɪvd ˈseɪfli ˈæftər ðə stɔrm/

examples.en: He let out a relieved sigh when the doctor confirmed the laboratory biopsy test was negative.
examples.vi: Anh thở phào nhẹ nhõm khi bác sĩ xác nhận kết quả xét nghiệm sinh thiết là âm tính.
examples.ipaUs: /hi lɛt aʊt ə rɪˈlivd saɪ wɛn ðə ˈdɑktər kənˈfɜrmd ðə ˈlæbrəˌtɔri ˈbaɪˌɑpsi tɛst wʌz ˈnɛɡətɪv/

words.vi: hương thơm, mùi hương; mùi vết tích săn mồi
words.senseNote: Mùi hương dễ chịu của hoa cỏ, nước hoa; hoặc dấu vết mùi mà động vật để lại.

examples.en: The sweet scent of blooming jasmine flowers drifted gently through the open bedroom window.
examples.vi: Hương thơm ngọt ngào của những bông hoa nhài nở rộ nhẹ nhàng bay qua khung cửa sổ phòng ngủ đang mở.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə swit sɛnt ʌv ˈblumɪŋ ˈdʒæzmɪn ˈflaʊərz ˈdrɪftəd ˈdʒɛntli θru ði ˈoʊpən ˈbɛdˌrum ˈwɪndoʊ/

examples.en: The search-and-rescue bloodhound tracked the missing child's scent across the damp forest trail.
examples.vi: Chú chó cứu hộ đánh hơi đã lần theo mùi hương của đứa trẻ bị lạc qua con đường mòn trong khu rừng ẩm ướt.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə sɜrtʃ ænd ˈrɛskju ˈblʌdˌhaʊnd trækt ðə ˈmɪsɪŋ tʃaɪldz sɛnt əˈkrɔs ðə dæmp ˈfɔrəst treɪl/

words.vi: cứng, đơ cứng (cơ thể); cứng đơ (vật liệu); cứng nhắc
words.senseNote: Khó uốn cong, khó cử động hoặc bị đau cơ sau khi vận động.

examples.en: Her neck and shoulders felt terribly stiff after sitting in front of a laptop for eight hours.
examples.vi: Cổ và vai của cô cảm thấy đơ cứng khủng khiếp sau khi ngồi trước máy tính xách tay suốt tám tiếng đồng hồ.
examples.ipaUs: /hər nɛk ænd ˈʃoʊldərz fɛlt ˈtɛrəbli stɪf ˈæftər ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪn frʌnt ʌv ə ˈlæpˌtɑp fɔr eɪt ˈaʊərz/

examples.en: The heavy canvas sails became stiff and rigid in the freezing Arctic ocean wind.
examples.vi: Những cánh buồm bằng vải bạt dày trở nên cứng đơ trong làn gió lạnh buốt của Bắc Băng Dương.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə ˈhɛvi ˈkænvəs seɪlz bɪˈkeɪm stɪf ænd ˈrɪdʒəd ɪn ðə ˈfrizɪŋ ˈɑrktɪk ˈoʊʃən wɪnd/

words.vi: bị nghiện, say mê không dứt ra được
words.senseNote: Lệ thuộc sâu sắc về mặt thể chất hoặc tâm lý vào chất kích thích, thói quen hoặc hành vi gây hại.

examples.en: The clinical counselor helped young patients who were heavily addicted to online gaming reclaim their daily lives.
examples.vi: Bác sĩ tham vấn tâm lý đã hỗ trợ các bệnh nhân trẻ nghiện game trực tuyến nặng lấy lại nhịp sống thường ngày.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə ˈklɪn.ɪ.kəl ˈkaʊn.sə.lɚ hɛlpt jʌŋ ˈpeɪ.ʃənts huː wɝː ˈhɛv.əl.i əˈdɪk.tɪd tu ˈɑːnˌlaɪn ˈɡeɪ.mɪŋ rɪˈkleɪm ðɛr ˈdeɪ.li laɪvz/

examples.en: He became addicted to sugary energy drinks during long nights of preparing for final university exams.
examples.vi: Anh ấy trở nên nghiện đồ uống tăng lực chứa nhiều đường trong những đêm dài ôn thi đại học cuối kỳ.
examples.ipaUs: /hi bɪˈkeɪm əˈdɪk.tɪd tu ˈʃʊɡ.ɚ.i ˈɛn.ɚ.dʒi drɪŋks ˈdʊr.ɪŋ lɑːŋ naɪts ʌv prɪˈpɛr.ɪŋ fɔːr ˈfaɪ.nəl ˌjuː.nəˈvɝː.sə.t̬i ɪɡˈzæmz/

words.vi: sự điều chỉnh, sự thích ứng tâm lý hoặc hoàn cảnh
words.senseNote: Hành động điều chỉnh nhỏ hoặc quá trình thích nghi tâm lý và cảm xúc trước tình huống mới.

examples.en: Moving to a foreign country requires a long period of emotional adjustment to different cultural customs.
examples.vi: Chuyển đến sống ở nước ngoài đòi hỏi một khoảng thời gian dài thích ứng tâm lý với các phong tục văn hóa khác biệt.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈmuː.vɪŋ tu ə ˈfɔːr.ən ˈkʌn.tri rɪˈkwaɪrz ə lɑːŋ ˈpɪr.i.əd ʌv ɪˈmoʊ.ʃən.əl əˈdʒʌst.mənt tu ˈdɪf.ɚ.ənt ˈkʌl.tʃɚ.əl ˈkʌs.təmz/

examples.en: With a subtle adjustment of his office chair height, his chronic neck pain gradually vanished.
examples.vi: Nhờ một sự điều chỉnh nhỏ độ cao ghế văn phòng, cơn đau cổ mãn tính của anh ấy dần biến mất.
examples.ipaUs: /wɪð ə ˈsʌt̬.əl əˈdʒʌst.mənt ʌv hɪz ˈɑː.fɪs tʃɛr haɪt hɪz ˈkrɑːn.ɪk nɛk peɪn ˈɡrædʒ.u.ə.li ˈvæn.ɪʃt/

words.vi: sự kinh ngạc kính sợ, cảm giác choáng ngợp trước vẻ đẹp hùng vĩ
words.senseNote: Cảm xúc sâu sắc kết hợp giữa lòng ngưỡng mộ, tôn kính và sự choáng ngợp trước điều lớn lao.

examples.en: The travelers stood in silent awe as golden morning sunlight flooded the vast mountain canyon.
examples.vi: Những người lữ hành đứng lặng người trong sự kinh ngạc choáng ngợp khi ánh nắng sớm vàng ươm tràn ngập hẻm núi hùng vĩ.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə ˈtræv.əl.ɚz stʊd ɪn ˈsaɪ.lənt ɑː æz ˈɡoʊl.dən ˈmɔːr.nɪŋ ˈsʌn.laɪt ˈflʌd.ɪd ðə væst ˈmaʊn.tən ˈkæn.jən/

examples.en: Watching the rocket launch into starry outer space filled young onlookers with genuine awe.
examples.vi: Chứng kiến tên lửa phóng vút vào không gian đầy sao làm những người trẻ theo dõi tràn ngập sự ngưỡng vọng kinh ngạc.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈwɑː.tʃɪŋ ðə ˈrɑː.kɪt lɑːntʃ ˈɪn.tu ˈstɑːr.i ˈaʊ.t̬ɚ speɪs fɪld jʌŋ ˈɑːnˌlʊk.ɚz wɪð ˈdʒɛn.ju.ɪn ɑː/

words.vi: sự bất mãn, cảm giác không hài lòng
words.senseNote: Tâm trạng buồn bực, bất mãn trước hoàn cảnh hiện tại hoặc cách đối xử không công bằng.

examples.en: Growing public discontent over rising fuel prices led to large demonstrations across major cities.
examples.vi: Sự bất mãn ngày càng gia tăng trong công chúng về giá nhiên liệu leo thang đã dẫn đến những cuộc biểu tình lớn khắp các thành phố lớn.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈɡroʊ.ɪŋ ˈpʌb.lɪk ˌdɪs.kənˈtɛnt ˈoʊ.vɚ ˈraɪ.zɪŋ ˈfjuː.əl ˈpraɪ.sɪz lɛd tu lɑːrdʒ ˌdɛm.ənˈstreɪ.ʃənz əˈkrɑːs ˈmeɪ.dʒɚ ˈsɪt̬.iz/

examples.en: Widespread worker discontent erupted when the factory management announced sudden wage cuts.
examples.vi: Sự bất mãn lan rộng của công nhân bùng nổ khi ban quản lý nhà máy thông báo cắt giảm lương đột ngột.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈwaɪd.sprɛd ˈwɝː.kɚ ˌdɪs.kənˈtɛnt ɪˈrʌp.tɪd wɛn ðə ˈfæk.tɚ.i ˈmæn.ədʒ.mənt əˈnaʊnst ˈsʌd.ən weɪdʒ kʌts/

words.vi: số phận bi thảm, sự diệt vong sụp đổ

examples.en: Aerobic exercise triggers the natural release of dopamine, producing a pleasant feeling of happiness and motivation.
examples.vi: Tập thể dục nhịp điệu kích hoạt sự giải phóng tự nhiên của dopamine, tạo ra cảm giác hạnh phúc và động lực dễ chịu.

examples.en: Social media notification alerts stimulate dopamine surges in the brain that encourage compulsive checking habits.

examples.en: Her academic performance in final examinations far exceeded every proud expectation of her parents.

passages.title: A Peaceful Morning in the Country Garden
passages.titleVi: Một buổi sáng thanh bình trong khu vườn thôn quê
passages.text: Every Saturday morning, Daniel enjoys visiting his grandmother's peaceful country home. When he first arrived today, he heard the cheerful songs of wild birds and saw blooming colorful flowers everywhere. There was no loud city traffic noise to disturb his quiet thoughts. He had a warm feeling of calm that instantly relaxed his tired mind. His grandmother came out to greet him with a gentle smile, and they began to laugh together about a cherished childhood memory. She offered him a fresh cup of tea and sweet honey cookies. Daniel told her that he was genuinely interested in learning her traditional gardening techniques. Last week, his back hurt after sitting at an office desk for many long hours. However, working gently outdoors made him forget the physical strain completely. His grandmother listened with deep care as he expressed his private feelings and plans. Daniel was deeply moved by her endless encouragement and thoughtful advice. He also shared his lifelong dream of opening a neighborhood plant nursery. The crisp morning breeze carried the fresh scent of pine trees and damp soil. Walking slowly along the stone path, he took several slow breaths and observed the gentle flutter of butterfly wings. In the busy city, continuous work deadlines often caused high anxiety and mental fatigue. Here in the serene countryside, every simple sensory impression felt vibrant and meaningful. Daniel realized that listening to one's body and emotional needs is essential for maintaining health. He promised to protect these precious hours every weekend without allowing digital distractions to intrude.

passages.title: Overcoming Grief and Rekindling Hope
passages.titleVi: Vượt qua nỗi đau và thắp lại hy vọng
passages.text: After weeks of isolating herself in a lonely apartment, Clara struggled with deep sorrow following the loss of her beloved grandmother. For days, she sat motionless on her armchair, staring out the rain-streaked window while remembering cherished childhood days. At times, quiet tears and soft crying overwhelmed her, and she hated feeling so completely helpless against her grief. Because she felt emotionally vulnerable, she initially hesitated to answer phone calls from well-meaning friends. However, yesterday afternoon, her lifelong friend Maya arrived with warm herbal tea and homemade blueberry muffins. Sitting closely beside Clara, Maya gave her a gentle pat on the shoulder and listened without judgment. Maya reminded Clara that while mourning takes time, one should never feel defeated by painful circumstances. To help lift her drooping spirits, Maya shared funny stories from their high school days, bringing a gentle sense of humor back into the quiet room. Later that evening, Clara opened an old photo album and read a touching letter of gratitude her grandmother had penned years ago. The heartfelt words reminded Clara of how deeply she was loved, and she was profoundly touched by the enduring wisdom left behind. Through the compassionate presence of her friend, Clara felt deeply encouraged to step outside into the fresh air once again. Looking up at the evening sky where stars began to shine, she began to feel truly blessed for the loving bonds that still surrounded her. Healing does not happen overnight, but genuine empathy and patient companionship provide the vital emotional strength needed to welcome tomorrow with renewed courage.

passages.title: Managing Emotions and Finding Inner Balance
passages.titleVi: Quản lý cảm xúc và tìm lại sự cân bằng nội tâm
passages.text: Living in a hectic modern city can challenge anyone's mental well-being and emotional balance. Last semester, David experienced considerable trouble balancing his demanding academic coursework with a strenuous part-time job. Whenever constant technical delays disrupted his computer laboratory projects, he initially felt mad and deeply upset. Minor daily setbacks, such as loud traffic horns or an annoying dripping faucet in his apartment, severely dampened his mood. Furthermore, David felt constantly worried that his persistent fatigue might negatively impact his overall physical health. One morning, he received news that his semester project partner had suddenly withdrawn from university, causing an unexpected shock that left him momentarily disoriented. However, rather than giving up, David sought guidance from the campus student counseling center. The counselor explained that experiencing diverse emotions is natural, but learning to process them mindfully builds resilience. She recommended regular outdoor exercise, such as morning cycling or gentle jogging, to reduce tension and refresh mental energy. David followed this healthy advice and was pleasantly surprised by how quickly daily walks improved his outlook. Within weeks, he completed the research project independently and was formally honored by the academic department with an achievement award. Standing before his supportive peers and mentors, David felt a profound surge of heartfelt joy and genuine gratitude. He realized that life inevitably brings stressful obstacles, but maintaining perspective transforms difficult challenges into personal wisdom. Today, when encountering difficult situations, David remains calm, knowing that patience and emotional care protect long-term peace of mind. Sharing his journey encourages other students to prioritize self-care, cultivate optimism, and celebrate the small victories of daily life.

passages.title: Finding Inner Peace Beyond Fear and Doubt
passages.titleVi: Tìm thấy bình an nội tâm vượt lên nỗi sợ hãi và nghi ngại
passages.text: Human emotions are complex currents that shape our daily experiences and psychological health. During challenging periods of life, people frequently encounter sudden moments of tension that require mindful patience. When unexpected obstacles emerge, it is easy to feel completely confused about what steps to take next. Last winter, Elena felt increasingly nervous before taking her final professional qualification exam. The night prior to the test, disturbing nightmares interrupted her sleep, causing a sudden surge of panic that made her heart race rapidly. Instead of letting irrational fear overwhelm her senses, she sat upright in bed and welcomed the soothing silence of the dark room. Taking slow, rhythmic breaths helped dissolve her anxiety and restore mental clarity. Although she initially felt disappointed after encountering several difficult questions on the test paper, Elena refused to entertain lingering regret. She reminded herself that feeling temporarily bored or fatigued during prolonged study sessions is a universal human reality. When the formal results were announced two weeks later, Elena was remarkably pleased to discover that she had passed with high marks. A warm tear of relief rolled down her smiling cheek as her supportive parents embraced her with pride. At that transformative moment, she realized that genuine happiness does not arise from avoiding difficult challenges, but from cultivating internal resilience. She felt profoundly grateful to her mentors and family whose gentle encouragement helped her persevere through doubt. By understanding our sensory reactions and emotional fluctuations, we learn that even intense fear eventually fades into lasting inner peace.

passages.title: Navigating Difficult Emotions and Finding Calm
passages.titleVi: Vượt qua cảm xúc khó khăn và tìm lại sự bình yên
passages.text: Learning how to understand our changing emotional reactions is an essential aspect of overall wellness. Last Friday afternoon, Maya was feeling distinctly uncomfortable after sitting on a stiff office stool for many hours. She was unhappy because an unexpected computer error had erased her daily progress report. A sudden shrill scream echoed from the adjacent corridor when a coworker dropped a tray of coffee mugs, followed by angry yelling that startled everyone in the quiet office. In that tense moment, Maya felt increasingly anxious about meeting her evening project deadlines. It was such a pity that small technical mishaps could spoil what had begun as a productive morning. Sadly, modern workplaces frequently produce stressful situations that test our inner patience. However, Maya remembered her counselor's advice on emotional regulation and decided to take a brief walk outdoors. Stepping into the sunlit garden park, she inhaled the cool autumn breeze and observed children playing happily near the water fountain. It was surprising how quickly fresh air and gentle movement can soothe a troubled mind. As she practiced mindful deep breathing, her racing heart slowed, and she felt calm and completely relaxed. Sitting on a park bench, she realized that temporary frustration does not have to dictate one's entire mood. When Maya returned to her desk with renewed clarity, she calmly resolved the software problem and completed her tasks. Cultivating emotional balance empowers us to transform stressful moments into valuable lessons of personal resilience. Taking time to breathe and step back restores emotional strength and peaceful focus.

passages.title: Overcoming Emotional Storms and Cultivating Inner Clarity
passages.titleVi: Vượt qua giông bão cảm xúc và vun bồi sự sáng suốt nội tâm
passages.text: Human emotions are intricate sensory currents that shape daily thoughts, relationships, and personal well-being. Last month, college student Liam experienced a deeply frustrating semester where unexpected academic obstacles challenged his peace of mind. Preparing for his final architecture presentation, he felt acute emotional distress after receiving a disappointing critique on his initial building blueprints. His intense dislike of public speaking and an embarrassing slip of the tongue during a rehearsal made him feel completely frightened whenever standing on stage. Unclear feedback threatened to confuse his design vision, while unhelpful day dreaming distracted him from revising his calculations. Watching his classmates achieve early success triggered an uncomfortable pang of envy, prompting Liam to pause and swallow his stubborn pride. Seeking guidance, he visited the university wellness counselor to discuss emotional balance. The counselor advised him not to confuse temporary setbacks with personal inadequacy. By setting aside digital screens that kept him hooked to late-night browsing, Liam learned to concentrate deeply on creative problem solving. He developed a genuine liking for morning mindfulness walks, where quiet reflection helped dissolve anxiety and satisfy his need for calm. That evening, his mother greeted him warmly, tenderly kissing his cheek and encouraging his enduring dreams. Learning how to manage mental distress through conscious breathing allows the nervous system to regain steady equilibrium. With renewed dedication and clearer purpose, he completed his architectural portfolio with remarkable confidence and grace. Embracing emotional mindfulness empowers students to transform vulnerability into profound resilience and joyful clarity. These mindful practices inspire students to navigate daily pressures with calm assurance and heartfelt optimism.

passages.title: A Peaceful Afternoon of Sensory Harmony and Mindful Awareness
passages.titleVi: Một buổi chiều bình yên của sự hòa hợp giác quan và nhận thức chánh niệm
passages.text: Cultivating sensory mindfulness allows us to recognize subtle emotional shifts and preserve inner equilibrium amid daily stress. On a warm Saturday afternoon, Maya visited a tranquil botanical conservatory to unwind from a hectic workweek. The greenhouse possessed a wonderfully pleasing fragrance of jasmine and damp moss, radiating a peaceful and restorative vibe. Sitting beside a gently trickling stone fountain, she felt visibly amused watching tiny sparrows splash cheerfully in the cool basin. Earlier that morning, she had felt temporarily offended by an unpleasant remark from a hurried coworker, but the natural greenery helped dissolve lingering irritation. Staying completely sober and present in the moment, she took slow breaths to center her awareness and release residual tension. After walking through the expansive sunlit glass pavilions, Maya felt slightly thirsty and enjoyed a refreshing glass of cold herbal infusion. Settling onto a comfortable cedar bench, she opened an illustrated book of botanical paintings, quickly becoming deeply absorbed in reading each detailed description. A library notice reminded visitors to maintain quiet voices so as not to disturb elderly patrons seeking peaceful relaxation. As soft golden sunlight filtered through leafy palm fronds, Maya felt pleasantly sleepy, her tired body relaxing naturally into the tranquil atmosphere. Looking up at the open sky through the glass dome, she closed her eyes, silently wishing for continued peace and emotional balance for her loved ones. These quiet moments of reflection demonstrate that self-care and gentle patience restore vitality to our minds and bodies. Cultivating inner peace through mindful awareness creates lasting resilience to navigate life's inevitable ups and downs.

passages.title: Managing Difficult Emotions and Finding Peace
passages.titleVi: Quản lý cảm xúc khó khăn và tìm kiếm sự bình yên
passages.text: Navigating complex emotional challenges and bodily sensations is an essential foundation of healthy personal growth for every individual. Many young adults arrive at our weekend community wellness workshop feeling troubled by intense academic pressure, career uncertainty, and interpersonal conflicts. Facing sudden catastrophic setbacks or overwhelming expectations can be an undeniably frightening experience that paralyzes self-confidence. During moments of acute nervous tension, rapid shallow breathing can suddenly make a person feel dizzy, lightheaded, and physically unsteady. Consequently, stressed students easily become distracted during important study hours, struggling to maintain mental focus on their daily assignments. Under such exhausting continuous strain, even innocent questions or minor background noises can quickly annoy someone and provoke sharp, impatient responses. When suppressed resentment and hurt feelings accumulate without constructive release, they often erupt into uncontrollable fury over relatively trivial household misunderstandings. Such explosive emotional clashes inevitably leave everyone in the family feeling deeply uneasy, anxious, and hesitant to communicate honestly. Furthermore, developing young adults must navigate powerful biological changes, sometimes feeling intensely randy, restless, or perplexed by strong romantic and sensual impulses. In our supportive workshop circles, mentors guide participants through calming breathwork, emotional journaling, and honest group discussions without fear of judgment. Participants learn that embracing sincere forgiveness frees the human heart from toxic grudges and helps heal fractured bonds with loved ones. Stepping outdoors into the fragrant cedar courtyard after afternoon meditation delivers an intensely satisfying sensation of grounded calmness and profound mental relief. By learning to observe these diverse emotional waves with gentle patience, we develop enduring inner strength and lifelong psychological balance.

passages.title: Overcoming Sensory Distress and Navigating Physical Illness
passages.titleVi: Vượt qua khủng hoảng cảm giác và đối phó với bệnh tật thể chất
passages.text: Listening closely to subtle bodily sensations helps individuals recognize early symptoms of illness before minor physical discomfort escalates into a severe health crisis. Last autumn, after working exhausting shifts in rainy weather, Marcus returned home feeling completely drained. That evening, he woke up in the middle of the night with a feverish forehead and uncontrollable shivering as sudden cold chills swept through his body. His entire frame felt bruised, with aching muscles and sore joints that made even simple movements painful. When he tried to get out of bed to fetch water, he felt remarkably dizzy, lightheaded, and physically unsteady. Furthermore, a severe allergic reaction to an unfamiliar herbal ointment caused sharp itching on his skin, accompanied by strange numbness in his fingertips. Later that morning, Marcus developed a splitting headache that throbbed relentlessly behind his temples. Deep coughing episodes brought a sharp tearing sensation in his chest muscles, leaving him in temporary agony. During that tortured night, sleep was nearly impossible as pain and physical exhaustion overwhelmed his mental reserves. Fortunately, his compassionate housemate arrived with warm broth and prescribed medicine, fulfilling his urgent craving for hydrating fluids and vitamin-rich citrus drinks. By resting in a quiet, dark bedroom and practicing slow abdominal breathing, Marcus allowed his overstimulated nervous system to decompress. Within forty-eight hours, the fever broke, the throbbing pain subsided, and natural bodily equilibrium returned. Recognizing somatic distress signals promptly enables people to seek proper rest and medical guidance before acute sensory discomfort compromises overall well-being. Practicing daily sensory mindfulness empowers everyone to maintain harmony between mind and body.

sentencePairs.vi: Nhờ nghỉ ngơi trong phòng ngủ tối và yên tĩnh cũng như thực hành thở bụng chậm rãi, Marcus đã để hệ thần kinh bị kích thích quá mức của mình được giải tỏa căng thẳng.

sentencePairs.en: Within forty-eight hours, the fever broke, the throbbing pain subsided, and natural bodily equilibrium returned.
sentencePairs.vi: Trong vòng bốn mươi tám giờ, cơn sốt đã dứt, cơn đau nhức nhối thuyên giảm và trạng thái cân bằng tự nhiên của cơ thể đã trở lại.

sentencePairs.en: Recognizing somatic distress signals promptly enables people to seek proper rest and medical guidance before acute sensory discomfort compromises overall well-being.
sentencePairs.vi: Nhận biết kịp thời các tín hiệu khủng hoảng thể chất cho phép mọi người tìm kiếm sự nghỉ ngơi hợp lý và chỉ dẫn y tế trước khi sự khó chịu cảm giác cấp tính làm tổn hại đến sức khỏe tổng thể.

sentencePairs.en: Practicing daily sensory mindfulness empowers everyone to maintain harmony between mind and body.
sentencePairs.vi: Thực hành chánh niệm giác quan mỗi ngày tiếp thêm sức mạnh cho mọi người duy trì sự hài hòa giữa tâm trí và cơ thể.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'feverish' phát âm là /ˈfiː.vɚ.ɪʃ/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu tiên với nguyên âm dài /iː/.

Từ 'numbness' có chữ cái 'b' hoàn toàn câm: /ˈnʌm.nəs/, trọng âm ở âm tiết đầu.
Từ 'splitting' phát âm là /ˈsplɪt.ɪŋ/, chú ý tổ hợp phụ âm đầu /spl/ và âm vỗ /t̬/ chuẩn Mỹ.

Complete numbness with absolute freedom from physical pain

comprehensionQuestions.question: What helped Marcus recover within forty-eight hours after his tortured night?

Staying awake for another three days working at his desk

passages.title: Navigating Emotional Storms and Cultivating Inner Gratitude
passages.text: During periods of prolonged personal hardship, many individuals encounter overwhelming emotional challenges that test their psychological resilience. At first, unexpected professional setbacks may trigger acute disappointment, causing dedicated workers to feel deeply lonely and afraid of what the uncertain future holds. When repeated obstacles accumulate, initial sadness can easily morph into sharp frustration, especially when months of disciplined labor seem entirely unrewarded. In the most difficult moments, an insidious sense of despair might threaten to extinguish motivation completely, bringing bitter tears to weary eyes. However, experienced mental wellness practitioners emphasize that painful feelings are transient mental states that can be navigated mindfully. When panic or anxiety begins to spiral, taking a deliberate moment to breathe deeply slows the heart rate and restores emotional equilibrium. Even amid overwhelming sorrow, paying mindful attention to the soothing touch of a loved one's hand or noticing the gentle warmth of sunshine can provide a faint glimmer of serenity. By meeting internal distress with patient curiosity rather than harsh self-judgment, individuals begin to untangle their complex emotional experiences. Gradually, an inspiring glimpse of renewed possibility emerges, reminding seekers of their profound capacity to persevere through hardship. Looking back on their journeys, many discover heartfelt gratitude for the quiet lessons learned during difficult days. Supportive counselors remind us that emotional healing requires patience, self-compassion, and regular moments of quiet reflection. Ultimately, learning to navigate emotional storms fosters deep compassion, equipping resilient people to extend genuine comfort to others who are struggling. Through empathy and patient listening, communities cultivate a welcoming environment where healing and emotional recovery flourish.

sentencePairs.vi: Trong những giai đoạn khó khăn cá nhân kéo dài, nhiều người phải đối mặt với những thách thức cảm xúc choáng ngợp thử thách khả năng phục hồi tâm lý của họ.

sentencePairs.en: By meeting internal distress with patient curiosity rather than harsh self-judgment, individuals begin to untangle their complex emotional experiences.

sentencePairs.en: Gradually, an inspiring glimpse of renewed possibility emerges, reminding seekers of their profound capacity to persevere through hardship.

sentencePairs.en: Looking back on their journeys, many discover heartfelt gratitude for the quiet lessons learned during difficult days.

sentencePairs.en: Supportive counselors remind us that emotional healing requires patience, self-compassion, and regular moments of quiet reflection.

sentencePairs.en: Through empathy and patient listening, communities cultivate a welcoming environment where healing and emotional recovery flourish.
sentencePairs.vi: Thông qua sự thấu cảm và lắng nghe kiên nhẫn, các cộng đồng tạo ra một môi trường thân thiện nơi sự chữa lành và hồi phục cảm xúc phát triển mạnh mẽ.

pronunciationNotesVi: Nối âm tự nhiên phụ âm sang nguyên âm: 'encounter overwhelming' (/ɪnˈkaʊn.t̬ɚ ˌoʊ.vɚˈwel.mɪŋ/), 'feel deeply' (/fiːl ˈdiːp.li/), 'touch of' (/tʌtʃ əv/), 'glimpse of' (/ɡlɪmps əv/).
Dạng nhược hóa của các từ chức năng (weak forms): 'of' (/əv/), 'to' (/tə/), 'and' (/ənd/), 'can be' (/kən biː/) được phát âm lướt nhẹ để tạo nhịp câu mượt mà.

Phát âm chuẩn âm đuôi và biến âm: Đuôi '-ed' phát âm là /t/ trong 'accumulate' (dạng quá khứ: /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪ.t̬ɪd/), /d/ trong 'learned' (/lɝːnd/), và đuôi '-s/-es' phát âm là /z/ trong 'tears' (/tɪrz/), 'lessons' (/ˈles.ənz/).
Ngữ điệu câu trần thuật và nhấn mạnh cảm xúc: Lên giọng nhẹ ở các vế đối sánh trước dấu phẩy (↗), và hạ giọng sâu lắng ở cuối câu khẳng định (↘) để truyền tải sự bình an và thấu hiểu.

passages.title: Therapeutic Resilience: Overcoming Sensory Trauma and Rebuilding Emotional Balance
passages.titleVi: Khả năng phục hồi trị liệu: Vượt qua chấn thương cảm giác và tái tạo sự cân bằng cảm xúc
passages.text: Recovering from psychological distress or chronic sensory fatigue requires patience, empathy, and professional clinical support. When an individual struggles with overwhelming emotional tension, consulting a compassionate therapist can facilitate a positive life transformation. Often, patients feeling addicted to compulsive digital behaviors find their sleep cycles and attention spans disrupted. A skilled counselor assists clients in making gradual behavioral adjustments and establishing healthy daily routines. In early sessions, individuals may temporarily feel uncomfortable opening up about deeply buried anxieties or past physical trauma. However, through warm verbal reassurance and structured cognitive exercises, patients learn to sustain emotional equilibrium under pressure. Soon thereafter, clients experience noticeable improvements in mental clarity and express genuine awe at their renewed inner vitality. Clinicians emphasize the virtue of practicing mindfulness and self-compassion when navigating stressful social encounters. Each person exhibits a distinct variation in sensory sensitivity, so therapeutic strategies are broadly tailored to meet individual developmental needs. Family members were thrilled to observe the recovering patient re-engaging enthusiastically in community activities, outdoor walks, and creative artistic pursuits. When people learn to interpret stressful physiological signals without panic, they build lasting mental resilience and self-confidence. Moreover, cultivating supportive relationships with trustworthy peers provides an enduring safety net during challenging life transitions. Modern behavioral therapy demonstrates that integrating regular verbal reflection with healthy physical exercise restores holistic emotional wellness for people of all ages. Community health centers continue to provide accessible counseling resources to ensure everyone receives timely psychological assistance. Ultimately, the collaborative journey between patient and therapist proves that proactive emotional care fosters enduring vitality, peace, and personal fulfillment.

sentencePairs.en: Recovering from psychological distress or chronic sensory fatigue requires patience, empathy, and professional clinical support.

sentencePairs.en: Often, patients feeling addicted to compulsive digital behaviors find their sleep cycles and attention spans disrupted.
sentencePairs.vi: Thông thường, những bệnh nhân cảm thấy nghiện các hành vi kỹ thuật số có tính cưỡng chế nhận thấy chu kỳ giấc ngủ và khoảng chú ý của họ bị gián đoạn.

sentencePairs.en: A skilled counselor assists clients in making gradual behavioral adjustments and establishing healthy daily routines.
sentencePairs.vi: Một chuyên viên tư vấn lành nghề hỗ trợ thân chủ thực hiện những điều chỉnh hành vi từng bước và thiết lập thói quen sinh hoạt lành mạnh hằng ngày.

sentencePairs.en: In early sessions, individuals may temporarily feel uncomfortable opening up about deeply buried anxieties or past physical trauma.
sentencePairs.vi: Trong những buổi đầu tiên, các cá nhân có thể tạm thời cảm thấy không thoải mái khi mở lòng về những lo âu chôn giấu sâu kín hoặc chấn thương thể chất trong quá khứ.

sentencePairs.en: However, through warm verbal reassurance and structured cognitive exercises, patients learn to sustain emotional equilibrium under pressure.

sentencePairs.en: Soon thereafter, clients experience noticeable improvements in mental clarity and express genuine awe at their renewed inner vitality.
sentencePairs.vi: Ngay sau đó, các thân chủ trải nghiệm những cải thiện rõ rệt về sự minh mẫn tinh thần và bày tỏ sự kinh ngạc chân thành trước sức sống nội tâm được tái sinh của mình.

sentencePairs.en: Clinicians emphasize the virtue of practicing mindfulness and self-compassion when navigating stressful social encounters.
sentencePairs.vi: Các nhà lâm sàng nhấn mạnh đức tính thực hành chánh niệm và lòng trắc ẩn với bản thân khi đối mặt với những cuộc gặp gỡ xã hội căng thẳng.

sentencePairs.en: Each person exhibits a distinct variation in sensory sensitivity, so therapeutic strategies are broadly tailored to meet individual developmental needs.
sentencePairs.vi: Mỗi người thể hiện một sự biến thiên riêng biệt về độ nhạy cảm giác, do đó các chiến lược trị liệu được điều chỉnh rộng rãi để đáp ứng nhu cầu phát triển của từng cá nhân.

sentencePairs.vi: Các trung tâm y tế cộng đồng tiếp tục cung cấp các nguồn lực tư vấn dễ tiếp cận để đảm bảo mọi người đều nhận được sự trợ giúp tâm lý kịp thời.

sentencePairs.en: Ultimately, the collaborative journey between patient and therapist proves that proactive emotional care fosters enduring vitality, peace, and personal fulfillment.
sentencePairs.vi: Cuối cùng, hành trình hợp tác giữa bệnh nhân và nhà trị liệu chứng minh rằng sự chăm sóc cảm xúc chủ động sẽ nuôi dưỡng sức sống bền lâu, sự an yên và niềm viên mãn cá nhân.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'therapist' /ˈθɛr.ə.pɪst/ bắt đầu bằng âm th vô thanh /θ/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu tiên /ˈθɛr-/, tránh phát âm nhầm thành âm /t/ hoặc /s/.
Từ 'variation' /ˌvɛr.iˈeɪ.ʃən/ có trọng âm chính ở âm tiết thứ ba /-ˈeɪ-/, âm đầu đọc rõ là nguyên âm /ɛr/ trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ.
Từ 'temporarily' /ˌtɛm.pəˈrɛr.əl.i/ có trọng âm chính ở âm tiết thứ ba /-ˈrɛr-/ theo chuẩn phát âm Mỹ thông dụng, hoặc trọng âm đầu /ˈtɛm-/, các âm schwa đọc lướt.
Từ 'thrilled' /θrɪld/ có cụm phụ âm đầu /θr-/, nguyên âm ngắn /ɪ/ và kết thúc bằng âm hữu thanh /d/ bật nhẹ.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How does a skilled behavioral counselor assist clients struggling with emotional fatigue?
options: By assisting them in making gradual behavioral adjustments and establishing healthy routines
By forcing them to work intensive commercial factory overtime shifts immediately
By prescribing unverified foreign herbal dyes without conducting physical examinations
By strictly forbidding patients from discussing personal anxieties with family members
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn chỉ rõ chuyên viên tư vấn hỗ trợ thân chủ thực hiện những điều chỉnh hành vi từng bước và thiết lập thói quen lành mạnh (making gradual behavioral adjustments and establishing healthy routines).

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why are therapeutic strategies broadly tailored to meet individual patient needs?
options: Because each person exhibits a distinct variation in sensory sensitivity
Because municipal health departments prohibit standardized cognitive exercises
Because commercial insurance providers require different laboratory blood tests
Because outdoor recreational walks are only suitable for young athletes
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn giải thích các chiến lược trị liệu được điều chỉnh linh hoạt vì mỗi người có sự biến thiên riêng biệt về độ nhạy cảm giác (each person exhibits a distinct variation in sensory sensitivity).

comprehensionQuestions.question: What positive outcome made family members feel thrilled during the patient's recovery?
options: Observing the patient re-engage enthusiastically in community activities and creative arts
Receiving an unexpected financial donation from an anonymous suburban philanthropist
Securing a commercial real estate mortgage for a private medical clinic
Watching the patient win an international competitive hundred-meter running sprint
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ người nhà vui mừng khi thấy bệnh nhân tham gia hào hứng trở lại các hoạt động cộng đồng và theo đuổi nghệ thuật (observe the recovering patient re-engaging enthusiastically in community activities, outdoor walks, and creative artistic pursuits).
